messages:
maria: FYI the new SDK shim rollout is creating split route metrics in the console. seeing both legacy and new headers logged. :confused:
ajay: yep. some requests have X-Redwood-Route and X-Rdw-RouteHint simultaneously. ingestion counts them separately.
kelly: can ingestion dedupe by semantic route rather than header name?
sam: quick fix: normalize headers and prefer the new one. e.g. `route = hdrs['x-rdw-routehint'] || hdrs['x-redwood-route']` then emit once. will lower-case header keys first.
ajay: SDK change: add env flag `REDWOOD_SHIM_STRICT=false` so early canaries keep both headers; docs note migration timeline.
maria: ops-bot, schedule raw export for 2026-03-19 -> 2026-03-21 so analytics can backfill.
ops-bot: export job export-506000-1 queued, ETA 40m.
kelly: add a dashboard tile showing "header split ratio" and alert if >3%. helps monitor rollout.
sam: rolling ingestion hotfix to canary eu-west now. will report.
(8m)
sam: canary looks clean, deploying cluster-wide. :thumbsup:
ajay: opened PR with env var + changelog. note about proxies normalizing casing included.
maria: thanks. i'll draft support/billing note after backfill. will post updates in #product.
